title: Drop the dropouts
hints: You don't need a second array. Use one index to **read** every element and another to **write** the ones you keep. The write index never gets ahead of the read index.
`size_t w = 0; for (size_t r = 0; r < count; r++) { ... }`. When `readings[r]` is not the sentinel, copy it to `readings[w]` and advance `w`. At the end, `w` is the new length.
`if (readings == NULL) return 0; size_t w = 0; for (size_t r = 0; r < count; r++) { if (readings[r] != sentinel) readings[w++] = readings[r]; } return w;`
